Chapter 6648: Supreme Heaven’S Assault

Chapter 6648: Supreme Heaven’s Assault

The avatar looked to be one with the world. It beckoned the image of an immemorial immortal that had passed away. However, the corpse turned into stars and still wielded its original power.

“This formation must be taken down before reaching Life and Death.” Top cultivators were speechless. This was the first line of defense.

“They certainly prepared well.” Spectators viewed it as an impregnable fortress.

“Absolutely, they learned a lesson from the previous failure. Their lord must succeed this time.” An old ancestor said.

The world explained Bodhi Ancestor’s failure with several theories. One stated his grand dao had a tiny deficiency. This was amplified infinitely when facing an immortal-level tribulation, resulting in his demise.

Another had no complaints about his cultivation and grand dao. However, Supreme Heaven launched all of its firepower. Of course, he had defenders as well including overlords. Alas, the enemies still made it through the gaps; their distraction caused his death.

Because of this, Life and Death Heaven prepared more than enough. Desolate Ancestor herself created a special formation to stop a mass-scale attack.

Eyes turned toward Supreme Heaven - the only possible party capable of disrespecting Lord of Life and Death.

Her faction was the strongest in Three Immortals. Only Supreme Heaven dared to oppose her. It didn’t wish to see her become an immortal or the power balance would collapse.

“Ooo-” Sure enough, the horns of war sounded in Supreme Heaven. They echoed across Three Immortals for a long time.

“Rumble!” Figures soared into the air, releasing their magnificent dao and chaos true energy. They entered Supreme Heaven to answer the call.

“Supreme Heaven is mobilizing.” Spectators saw reclusive cultivators appearing everywhere.

“You’re not going?” Someone asked Godstallion Marshal.

“Haha, why would I?” He shook his head: “My mission is over since Lord Dingtian is no longer around, I’m retired.”

His loyalty was with Dingtian so after his death, he no longer worked for Supreme Heaven.

“Creak.” The draconic gate of Supreme Heaven slowly opened. A portal before it also lit up and shot a beam into the air, activating a warp gate meant for legions.

Only the two heavens possessed warp gates capable of teleporting massive legions with pinpoint accuracy.

“Boom!” Wondrous visions appeared beyond the gate. Their various affinities permeated across the area.

It looked to be a paradise with auspicious beasts and birds. Any living being could become powerful due to its plentiful worldly energy.

A dark presence surged outward, followed by a great legion. It looked like a supreme devil had descended and scared the hell out of everyone.

Each soldier wore black armor and had a billowing black aura. Eventually, these auras took the form of a black dragon raising its claws, capable of tearing the world apart.

However, these black auras weren’t quite evil. It was pure and violent, not necessarily part of the dark path.
